speaker: richard_burbage
text: The guns have started. We go down from here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: From this door. The hill is where we stand. I am not making a halt between.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Augustine and I are coming. You named the barges, and I will not hear a prince from a settle.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I have your pointing in my sleeve from Thursday. I am not bringing it out on a hill. If they have a trumpet, I want that.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Fifteen, if the river is honest. Come and see how a man gets out of a boat. Thou wilt have opinions, Will. Bring them with thee.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Errors at two, after we are back. I am in it. The first Caesar is the Rose, and he can keep it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: We come back. You are a hard man to take to a sight, Master Shakespeare. Lead on, Dick. I will follow the noise, since you will follow him.
